import unittest
from copy import deepcopy

from solution import append_partitioned


class AppendPartitionedTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_appends_existing_and_adds_new_partitions_in_order(self):
        storage = {"alpha": [1, 2], "beta": [3]}
        additions = {"beta": [4, 5], "gamma": [6], "delta": []}
        result = append_partitioned(storage, additions)
        self.assertEqual(result, {"alpha": [1, 2], "beta": [3, 4, 5], "gamma": [6], "delta": []})
        self.assertEqual(list(result), ["alpha", "beta", "gamma", "delta"])
        self.assertEqual(storage, {"alpha": [1, 2], "beta": [3]})
        self.assertEqual(additions, {"beta": [4, 5], "gamma": [6], "delta": []})

    def test_empty_inputs(self):
        self.assertEqual(append_partitioned({}, {}), {})
        self.assertEqual(append_partitioned({"a": []}, {}), {"a": []})
        self.assertEqual(append_partitioned({}, {"a": [1]}), {"a": [1]})

    def test_all_nested_values_are_deeply_isolated(self):
        storage = {"a": [{"nested": [[1]]}], "untouched": [{"x": 2}]}
        additions = {"a": [{"added": [3]}], "new": [{"n": 4}]}
        storage_before = deepcopy(storage)
        additions_before = deepcopy(additions)
        result = append_partitioned(storage, additions)

        storage["a"][0]["nested"][0].append(9)
        additions["a"][0]["added"].append(8)
        additions["new"][0]["n"] = 10
        self.assertEqual(result["a"], [{"nested": [[1]]}, {"added": [3]}])
        self.assertEqual(result["new"], [{"n": 4}])

        result["a"][0]["nested"][0].append(7)
        result["a"][1]["added"].append(6)
        result["untouched"][0]["x"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(storage["a"][0]["nested"], [[1, 9]])
        self.assertEqual(additions["a"][0]["added"], [3, 8])
        self.assertEqual(storage_before, {"a": [{"nested": [[1]]}], "untouched": [{"x": 2}]})
        self.assertEqual(additions_before, {"a": [{"added": [3]}], "new": [{"n": 4}]})

    def test_mapping_types_are_required(self):
        for storage, additions in (([], {}), ({}, []), (None, {}), ({}, None)):
            with self.subTest(storage=storage, additions=additions):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    append_partitioned(storage, additions)

    def test_partition_key_validation(self):
        for bad in (1, None, ("a",)):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    append_partitioned({bad: []}, {})
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    append_partitioned({}, {bad: []})
        for bad in ("", "   ", "\t"):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    append_partitioned({bad: []}, {})
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    append_partitioned({}, {bad: []})

    def test_record_collections_must_be_lists(self):
        for records in ((), {}, "records", None):
            with self.subTest(records=records):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    append_partitioned({"a": records}, {})
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    append_partitioned({}, {"a": records})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
